connect.title: Connect your tenant
connect.description: A Global Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator of your Microsoft 365 tenant grants LicenseMeter read-only application permissions once. That unlocks nightly monitoring, leak alerts and trends. Nothing is ever written to your tenant, and mailbox or file contents are never readable.
connect.consentNotEnabled: One-click managed consent is not enabled on this deployment. Use the instant scan or CSV import below.

instantScan.title: Run an instant scan
instantScan.description: One-time scan with the same read-only scopes, running with your permissions while you are signed in. No standing access, no stored tokens.

noAdmin.description: No admin with consent rights at hand? Start with the CSV import: two admin-center exports, no consent at all.

csv.title: Your waste number from two exports, no consent
csv.description: Upload the exports below and LicenseMeter runs the same waste rules a connected workspace gets: offboarding leaks, overlapping licenses and (with the usage file) inactive seats. Anyone with Reports Reader or Global Reader rights can produce the exports; no admin consent is involved.

dataHandling.heading: How your data is handled
dataHandling.body: The files are read once and stored like synced workspace data: EU residency, never written back anywhere, no mailbox or file contents. Disconnecting the workspace in Settings deletes everything.

csv.connectInsteadSuffix: for nightly updates, leak alerts and trends without re-uploading.

form.directoryHelp: Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > Export users. It shows who holds which licenses, and who is blocked.
form.usageHelp: Reports > Usage > Active users > Export (detail). This adds inactivity detection on top of the offboarding and overlap checks.
